title: GenomeDisplayConfig
description: Serializable description of one mounted genome-organization display. Every render-affecting choice is either here or derived deterministically from this config plus the referenced data. Data is referenced, never embedded: supply URLs for the fetch path, or rows for the injection path.

version.description: Config schema version. A reader rejects a config whose version exceeds the version it was built against; older versions are migrated forward. See DESIGN.md, 'Config versioning'.

data.description: Which data to display. URLs are fetched by the display; rows are supplied by the caller and are never written out by configFromState.

rows.description: Alignment rows: qseqid, sseqid, pident, length, qstart, qend, qlen, sstart, send, slen, genome, coverage.

geneAnnotationRows.description: Gene annotation rows. The first key, or 'gene_id' if present, is the gene identifier.

genomeAnnotationRows.description: Genome annotation rows. The first key, or 'genome_id' if present, is the genome identifier.

referenceGenome.description: Genome drawn as the outer contig ring. Null selects the first genome alphabetically.

visibleGenomes.description: Genomes drawn as inner rings. Null means every genome except the reference. The canonical form: configFromState always writes this field and never hiddenGenomes.

hiddenGenomes.description: Input-only alias for visibleGenomes, expressed as a complement: every genome except the reference and these. Ignored when visibleGenomes is present. Exists so the standalone app's ?hidden= links keep resolving.

genomeOrder.description: Explicit ring order, as produced by the gene-content sort. Null falls back to the sort column, then alphabetical.

categoryColumn.description: Annotation column that drives the gene highlight track. Null disables the track.

labelColumn.description: Annotation column shown as the gene name in the tooltip.

selectedCategories.description: Category values that are highlighted. Empty highlights nothing.

customColors.description: Per-category colour overrides, category value to #rrggbb.

colorColumn.description: Annotation column that colours genome rings.

groupColumn.description: Annotation column that groups and sorts rings. Overrides colorColumn for colour and sortColumn for order.

labelColumn.description: Annotation column shown instead of the genome id.

tooltipColumns.description: Extra annotation columns listed in the tooltip.

zoom.description: The magnifying wedge. These are the spring targets, not a mid-animation sample: applying a config snaps to them so a rehydrated display reproduces the view exactly.

focusAngle.description: Genome angle at the wedge centre, radians clockwise from 12 o'clock.

wedgeSpan.description: Wedge width as a fraction of the full circle.

wedgeGap.description: Pixel gap between the main circle and the wedge.

wedgeHeightScale.description: Radial share of the viewport given to the wedge. Larger shrinks the main circle.

theme.description: Colour theme. Chooses the genome palette, the annotation track tint, the contig label colour and the export background.

controls.description: Render the sidebar. False mounts the figure alone, for a host application that supplies its own controls.

controlsCollapsed.description: Start with the sidebar collapsed. Ignored when controls is false.
